app.name: LionPhotos
workbench.preloadMissing: The secure bridge (preload) did not load. Restart LionPhotos.
labels.descriptionPlaceholder: What it is about, for whom, when… (optional)
labels.removeFromTitle: Unlinks the selected items from “{name}”; faces recognized in them stop pointing to it (the files are not changed)
labels.forFolder: Category, projects, people, pets, places and albums of this folder
labels.folderHint: Applies to everything inside this folder, subfolders included. Only LionPhotos’ catalog changes; no file is touched.
labels.filesHint: Applies to the selected files. A file’s category and project win over its folder’s; people, pets and places add up.
labels.noneYet: No project, person, pet or place yet.
labels.howTo: Create one above, then use “Labels…” on a folder in the side bar or on selected photos.
labels.deleteMessage.one: It is removed from {count} item. The files are not touched.
labels.deleteMessage.other: It is removed from {count} items. The files are not touched.
labels.deleteMessageEmpty: No item has it. The files are not touched.
labels.deleteNote: Only the label is deleted from LionPhotos’ catalog; your photos and videos stay as they are.
labels.type.project.name: Project name
labels.type.project.lead: A job, a study or a commission.
labels.type.person.name: Person’s name
labels.type.person.lead: Who appears in the photos. A photo can have several people.
labels.type.pet.name: Pet’s name
labels.type.place.name: Place name
labels.type.place.lead: Where the photos were taken: a city, a building, a site visit.
labels.type.album.name: Album name
labels.type.album.lead: Photo albums put together by hand.
labels.emptyFind.person: Let LionPhotos look for the people in your photos, on this computer.
labels.emptyFind.pet: Let LionPhotos look for the pets in your photos, on this computer.
labels.emptyOr: Or create one by hand, in the field above.
albums.noPersonal: No album with personal photos yet.
albums.noProfessional: No album with professional photos yet.
albums.lead: Choose the best photos of a trip, a party or a job and keep them together, with a cover and a description, ready to show as a slideshow. A photo can be in several albums; the files stay where they are — nothing is copied.
albums.name: Name
albums.nameMissing: Give the new album a name.
albums.howTo: Create one above, or select photos in Photos and use “Add to album…”.
albums.addTitleHint: Put the selected photos in an album (new or existing). No file is copied.
albums.addNote: Only the LionPhotos catalog changes: the photos stay in their folders, and the same photo can be in several albums.
albums.removeTitle: Take the selected items out of “{name}” (the files are not touched)
albums.viaFolder.one: {count} item is in “{name}” because its whole folder is: take the folder out with “Labels…” on the folder in the side bar.
albums.viaFolder.other: {count} items are in “{name}” because their whole folder is: take the folder out with “Labels…” on the folder in the side bar.
albums.coverTitle: Show this photo on the album’s cover
albums.deleteMessage.one: The album with {count} item is deleted. The photos themselves are not touched.
albums.deleteMessage.other: The album with {count} items is deleted. The photos themselves are not touched.
albums.deleteMessageEmpty: The album has no photos. Nothing else changes.
albums.deleteNote: Only the album leaves the LionPhotos catalog; your photos and videos stay as they are.
albums.merge.title: Merge “{name}”
albums.merge.lead.one: The {count} item in “{name}” goes to the album you pick, and “{name}” is gone.
albums.merge.lead.other: The {count} items in “{name}” go to the album you pick, and “{name}” is gone.
albums.merge.name: Name of the merged album
albums.merge.summaryCommon.one: It will have {count} item ({common} already in both).
albums.merge.summaryCommon.other: It will have {count} items ({common} already in both).
albums.merge.note: Only the catalog changes: no file moves. The chosen album keeps its description, cover and project; what it lacks comes from “{name}”.
albums.merge.noOther: There is no other album to merge with.
albums.cover.title: Cover of “{name}”
albums.cover.lead.one: Pick the photo for the album’s cover (a double click uses it).
albums.cover.lead.other: Pick one of its {count} photos for the album’s cover (a double click uses it).
albums.cover.none: This album has no photo with a thumbnail to use as its cover.
albums.cover.autoTitle: The cover goes back to the album’s first photo
albums.searchNone: No album by that name — a new one can be made below.
slideshow.startTitle: Show the photos one after another, full screen (P in the viewer)
settings.title: Settings
settings.tileDetailsHint: Off: only RAW and the length of videos show on the photos.
settings.focusHint: Only the photos: no side bar, info panel or header. The same key, or Esc, brings them back.
nls.changeHint: the window reloads in the new language
marks.label: Mark
marks.trashRejects.other: Delete the {count} files from the Limbo
marks.trashRejectsTitle: Send every delete candidate of this folder ({size}) to the Recycle Bin, with the confirmation code
marks.hint: Keys 1 · 2 · 3 mark the selection, 0 clears. Only LionPhotos’ catalog changes.
titlebar.placeholder: Open a folder of photos and videos
activitybar.toggleSidebar: Show or hide the side bar ({key})
selection.removeTitle: Take “{name}” off {n} selected item(s) (the files are not touched)
selection.fromFolder: Comes from their folder: change it with “Labels…” on the folder
selection.noAlbums.other: None of them is in an album.
selection.noPeople.one: Nobody marked in this photo yet.
selection.noPeople.other: Nobody marked in these items yet.
selection.noPets.one: No pet in this photo yet.
selection.noPets.other: No pet in these items yet.
selection.noPlaces.one: No place for this photo yet.
selection.noPlaces.other: No place in these items yet.
sphere.scopeTitle: The photos this page is drawn from: choose in the title bar
sphere.pickTitle: Show personal photos, professional photos, the ones not categorized yet, or all
sphere.label: Category
sphere.clearAll: Take the category off (the files’ own; a folder’s stays)
sphere.fromFolder.one: {count} gets its category from its folder
sphere.fromFolder.other: {count} get their category from their folder
faces.autoOn: On: new photos are looked at after each refresh.
faces.autoOff: Off: faces are looked for only when you choose “Index now”.
faces.autoHint: On: LionPhotos looks for faces in new and changed photos after each refresh, in the background.
faces.indexNowTitle: Look for faces in the photos of this collection not looked at yet
faces.lastTitle: When the photos of this collection were last looked at for faces
faces.unsupported: This computer does not support face recognition.
faces.unsupportedGpu: It needs graphics acceleration (a graphics card with WebGL); on the processor alone every photo would take many seconds.
faces.unsupportedMemory: It needs at least 4 GB of memory (this computer has {detail}).
faces.gpuBoostTitle: Restarts LionPhotos asking for the high-performance graphics card and ignoring Chromium’s block list. It can be undone.
faces.gpuBoostOffTitle: Restarts LionPhotos without asking for the dedicated graphics card
faces.tryAnywayTitle: Starts the recognition for real: if it gets the graphics card, it stays on
faces.offTitle: Recognize the faces in this collection
faces.offLead: LionPhotos finds the faces in the photos and puts the similar ones together. You give a name once; the person is then marked in their other photos — as a suggestion you can confirm or correct.
faces.private: Everything happens on this computer: no photo or face is sent anywhere. Only the LionPhotos catalog changes; your files stay as they are.
faces.summary: {photos} photos looked at · {faces} faces. New photos are looked at after each refresh.
faces.stopTitle: Turn face recognition off for this collection (the faces and people found stay)
faces.stopMessage: No new photo will be looked at. The faces already found, the names and the people of each photo stay.
faces.peopleLead: Who appears in the photos. A photo can have several people. With face recognition on, LionPhotos marks them by their face.
faces.toCheck.one: {count} face suggested by LionPhotos waits to be checked: open the person.
faces.toCheck.other: {count} faces suggested by LionPhotos wait to be checked: open each person.
faces.howToNamed: Give a name to a group of faces below, or create a person above.
faces.whoLead: Similar faces nobody has named yet. Type a name (a new person or one you already have) and press Enter: every face of the group gets it, and LionPhotos suggests that person in the other photos. × takes a face out of the group.
faces.groupsWaiting: The groups appear here as the photos are looked at.
faces.groupsNone: Every face found has a name — or was ignored.
faces.notInGroup: Not this person: take out of the group (ignored)
faces.ignoreGroupTitle: Strangers, background faces: they leave the groups and are never suggested
faces.ignoredLead: Faces that are not marked and never suggested. Bring one back to the groups if needed.
faces.suggestedLead: Faces LionPhotos found like those of {name}. The photos already have {name}; ✓ confirms, × says it is not them (never suggested again).
faces.deleteNote: Only the person leaves the LionPhotos catalog; their faces become unknown again. Your photos stay as they are.
pets.autoOn: On: new photos are looked at after each refresh.
pets.autoOff: Off: pets are looked for only when you choose “Index now”.
pets.autoHint: On: LionPhotos looks for pets in new and changed photos after each refresh, in the background.
pets.indexNowTitle: Look for pets in the photos of this collection not looked at yet
pets.lastTitle: When the photos of this collection were last looked at for pets
pets.unsupported: This computer does not support pet recognition.
pets.private: Everything happens on this computer: no photo is sent anywhere. Only the LionPhotos catalog changes; your files stay as they are.
pets.summary: {photos} photos looked at · {faces} animals. Dogs, cats, birds, horses, sheep and cows are found.
pets.peopleLead: The animals in the photos. LionPhotos finds dogs, cats, birds, horses, sheep and cows and puts the ones that look alike together; two animals of the same breed can look alike, so check the suggestions.
pets.toCheck.one: {count} animal suggested by LionPhotos waits to be checked: open the pet.
pets.toCheck.other: {count} animals suggested by LionPhotos wait to be checked: open each pet.
pets.howToNamed: Give a name to a group of animals below, or create a pet above.
pets.whoLead: Animals that look alike and have no name yet. Type a name (a new pet or one you already have) and press Enter: every animal of the group gets it, and LionPhotos suggests that pet in the other photos. × takes one out of the group.
pets.groupsWaiting: The groups appear here as the photos are looked at.
pets.groupsNone: Every animal found has a name — or was ignored.
pets.notInGroup: Not this pet: take out of the group (ignored)
pets.ignoreGroupTitle: Animals that are not your pets: they leave the groups and are never suggested
pets.ignoredLead: Animals that are not marked and never suggested. Bring one back to the groups if needed.
pets.suggestedLead: Animals LionPhotos found like {name}. The photos already have {name}; ✓ confirms, × says it is not them (never suggested again).
pets.deleteNote: Only the pet leaves the LionPhotos catalog; its pictures become unknown again. Your photos stay as they are.
home.title: Start: every photo and video of the collection, without filters ({key})
home.allYearsTitle: Show the photos of every year again
panels.title: {name} in the side bar (click again to hide it)
panels.datesHint: A year shows only its photos in Photos (by the date taken, or the file date).
sidebar.title: Library
sidebar.hint.none: Only the folder itself, no subfolders.
sidebar.refreshTitle: Look for new and changed files in “{folder}” and its subfolders ({key}). Unchanged files keep their thumbnails.
sidebar.scope: Only “{folder}” and its subfolders are read — nothing else on the disk.
sidebar.emptyTree: Open a folder to see its subfolders here.
statusbar.thumbsTitle: Thumbnails being made in the background; the ones on screen come first
statusbar.revealTitle.other: Show the selected items (each click goes to the next one)
statusbar.themeTealTitle: Watermelon theme — the teal of the logo, pink and white
statusbar.themeCityTitle: City blue theme — cobalt, coral and white, like an urban plan
statusbar.thumbsKept: Thumbnails are kept in the catalog and never made again: {kept} were ready, only the {missing} missing ones are being made.
welcome.lead: Open a folder to browse its photos and videos as thumbnails, search them by name, camera, author or codec, and organize them into folders.
welcome.shortcuts.refresh: Look for new and changed files
welcome.note: Thumbnails are made once and kept in a small local cache; they are made again only when a file changes. Nothing leaves your computer.
broad.message: LionPhotos reads only the folder you choose and its subfolders. “{folder}” holds everything on it, so every folder of it would be read.
broad.note: Usually it is better to choose the folder where the photos are (e.g. Pictures, or a folder of the project).
photos.noAlbumTitle: Shows only the photos and videos that are not in any album yet
photos.noAlbumClear: Show the ones in albums too
photos.searchPlaceholder: Search name, folder, camera, author, codec…
photos.sort.name: Name
photos.moreTitle: More for the selection: open, rename, move, organize, Recycle Bin…
photos.subfoldersHint: Also show the items of the subfolders of the folder in focus
photos.empty.title: No photos or videos here
photos.empty.hint: This folder has no photos or videos. Choose another folder in the tree, or turn on "Subfolders".
photos.empty.filteredHint: Try other words, another year or another type.
photos.spotOn: Highlights: only the photos marked great or OK, large
photos.why.thisFolder: Only this folder, without its subfolders
photos.why.hiddenIn.one: It has {count} item: the filters below hide it.
photos.why.hiddenIn.other: It has {count} items: the filters below hide them.
photos.why.hidden.one: There is {count} item here: the filters below hide it.
photos.why.hidden.other: There are {count} items here: the filters below hide them.
list.name: Name
category.hint.original: Camera photos (JPEG, HEIC, TIFF) that were not edited
category.hint.edited: Edited copies: -Edit, -2… in the name, or saved by Lightroom, Photoshop and other editors
category.hint.raw: Camera raw files (CR2, NEF, ARW, DNG…)
category.hint.graphic: PNG, GIF, WebP and other images: screenshots, scans, artwork
info.notOrganized: Not in any album, person, place or project yet
info.nextTitle: The next photo, with the panel as it is (Alt+↓; Alt+↑ goes back)
info.empty: Select a photo or video to see its details.
info.author: Author
info.title: Title
info.dayTitle: Leaves here and shows every photo and video of {day} in Photos
viewer.editTitle: Show or fold the editing panel: category, albums, adjustments, description, author and place (H)
viewer.outOfFilter: This photo is now in {category}. It stays here while the viewer is open; after closing it, find it with the category filter “{category}” in the title bar.
viewer.zoomToggle: Fit to the screen ↔ actual size (Z) · the wheel zooms where the mouse is, drag to move
viewer.label: Viewer
viewer.imageUnsupported: {format} files cannot be shown at full size here; this is their thumbnail.
viewer.videoUnsupported: This video ({format}) cannot be played here.
viewer.rawPreview: Camera JPEG · {size} (the largest kept in this file)
viewer.rawNoteTitle: Every raw file carries a JPEG the camera made from it, with its own settings. This is that picture — the same that Lightroom and the system viewers show before the photo is developed.
viewer.rawDevelopedTitle: Drawn from the sensor data, developed on this computer in 16 bits (LibRaw). Before/after (Y) compares it with the camera's JPEG.
previews.one: Generate the 5-second preview of this video
previews.folderTitle: Make 5-second previews of the videos of this folder
previews.nothingToDo: These videos already have their previews.
previews.confirm.message: A short clip of the first 5 seconds, at thumbnail size, is made for {scope}. It plays when you rest the mouse on the video.
previews.confirm.note: This takes processing time. It runs in the background, one video at a time and only after the thumbnails — you can keep using LionPhotos, and stop it in the status bar.
previews.started.one: {count} video added to the preview queue.
previews.started.other: {count} videos added to the preview queue.
overview.title: Overview
overview.kindsHint: Larger petal = more files. Click to see them.
overview.previewsHint: Generate the 5-second previews of every indexed video, in the background.
overview.byYearHint: Click a year to see it
overview.camerasHint: From the metadata of the files
overview.noMeta: Shown as the thumbnails are made.
overview.cacheHint: Thumbnails and previews, made once and kept in the catalog; made again only when a file changes. Your photos are not counted.
overview.space.portableTitle: The catalog kept with the photos, in the hidden .lionphotos folder of each root folder (— when the drive is not connected)
dupes.title: Repeated files
dupes.lead: Finds identical copies by content, not by name: sizes first, then the beginning and end of each file, and the whole file only when still needed. Pick the copy to keep; the others go to the Recycle Bin.
dupes.noneHint: Every photo and video in this collection is unique.
dupes.trashCopies.one: Move {count} copy to the Recycle Bin
dupes.trashCopies.other: Move {count} copies to the Recycle Bin
dupes.trashAll.one: Move {count} extra copy to the Recycle Bin…
dupes.trashAll.other: Move {count} extra copies to the Recycle Bin…
organize.splitHint: In each folder: camera raw files (and their .xmp) in Raw/, JPG, PNG, HEIC… in Img/; videos stay in the folder.
organize.byAlbumHint: Each album to “year/year-month-day-album”, dated by its first photo. A photo in two albums goes with the one that starts first; each album keeps its photos through its new folder.
organize.title: Organize the collection
organize.lead: Every change shows its plan first and asks for a code you type. Moves can be undone below.
organize.byDateHint: Uses the date the photo was taken (EXIF), or the file date when there is none.
organize.moveLead: Moves the items to a folder you choose, split into subfolders by kind. Files of the same shot (raw, Lightroom sidecar, edited and original JPEG) go together.
organize.renameHint: A new name for each photo, on the disk. The raw file, the JPEG and the .xmp of a shot keep the same name.
organize.renameNote: Numbered by date in each folder. No file is overwritten; undo brings back the old names and folders.
organize.sameHint: The files stay in their folders and only get their new names.
move.subHint.raw: CR2, NEF, ARW, DNG… with their .xmp
move.relatedHint: Files of the same shot in the same folder: the raw file, Lightroom’s .xmp sidecar and the edited and original JPEGs with the same name.
backup.title: Backup
backup.lead: Choose a master folder and a backup folder, on any disks. They are compared by content, subfolders included — whatever the names and places — so you see what is in both, what is missing from the backup and what exists only in the backup.
backup.exact: Check the content of every file (slower)
backup.exactHint: Without it, a file with the same subfolder, name, size and date on both sides is taken as the same without being read. With it, every possible pair is compared byte by byte (SHA-256).
backup.safe: Comparing only reads. Copying asks for the confirmation code, never replaces a file, and checks every copy against its original.
backup.stage.quick: Comparing files of the same size… {done} of {total}
backup.stage.full: Reading whole files to be sure… {pct}% of {size}
backup.tabHint.onlyMaster: Not in the backup yet: copy them to complete it.
backup.tabHint.both: The same photo on both sides, in the same subfolder or somewhere else.
backup.tabHint.onlyBackup: In the backup but not in the master: deleted from the master, or never there.
backup.empty.onlyMaster: Every photo of the master is in the backup.
backup.empty.both: No photo is on both sides.
backup.empty.onlyBackup: The backup has nothing the master does not.
backup.catalog.current: The catalog (albums, people, marks, descriptions, adjustments) is in the backup too, as of {when}.
backup.catalog.older: The backup has an older copy of the catalog ({when}): albums, people and adjustments made since are not in it.
backup.catalog.missing: The backup has no copy of the catalog: it has the photos, not the albums, people, descriptions and adjustments.
backup.catalog.copy: Copy the catalog to the backup
backup.catalog.copied: The catalog was copied to the backup.
renameFile.title: Rename “{name}”
renameFile.label: New name (the extension stays)
contextMenu.renameOne: Rename works on one file at a time
projects.stat.editedHint: with an edited version next to them
projects.stat.altMissing.one: {count} photo of the albums still without
projects.stat.altMissing.other: {count} photos of the albums still without
plugins.view.pickHint: Click the albums and projects to export, or export and choose there.
plugins.view.empty: No albums or projects with photos yet
plugins.view.emptyHint: This plugin exports: {types}. Make one and add photos to it.
plugins.view.tabTitle: its page: export albums and projects
plugins.view.previewTitle: See the photos that will be exported
plugins.view.openTitle: Open “{name}” in Photos, to see and change it. Back returns to this page.
plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.hint: Packages that export albums and projects as a page (HTML, CSS and JavaScript). They run no code inside LionPhotos.
plugins.removed: Plugin removed (it is in the Recycle Bin).
plugins.noneHint: Install a .lionplugin package to export albums and projects as a page.
plugins.export.zipHint: One file with the page and the photos, next to the folder: to send or attach.
plugins.export.zipDone: A copy of everything is in “{zip}”.
plugins.export.zipSkipped: The .zip was not made (over 4 GB); the folder has everything.
plugins.export.buttonTitle: Export as a page with a plugin
plugins.export.title: Export with a plugin
plugins.export.note: A new folder is made with the page and copies of the photos. Your photos are not changed.
plugins.export.empty: Nothing to export: the albums and projects chosen have no photos.
plugins.which.label: Photos to export
plugins.same.title.one: A photo with the same name as another
plugins.same.title.other: {count} photos with the same name as another
plugins.same.text: On the page they would be two photos under one name. Choose which one goes of each; the other stays out of this export.
crop.title: Crop and straighten
crop.canvasLabel: The photo with the crop: drag inside to move it, the corners and sides to resize it
crop.levelHint: Draw a line along the horizon (or along something that should be straight)
crop.levelNote: Drag the slider, or use “Level” and draw a line over the horizon. A double click on the slider goes back to 0°.
crop.cannot: This photo could not be opened for cropping.
crop.removeTitle: Back to the whole photo, not rotated or straightened
trashlog.title: Recycle Bin history
trashlog.lead: The files LionPhotos sent to the system’s Recycle Bin, and how much space the Limbo freed. The disk gets the space back when the Recycle Bin is emptied.
trashlog.emptyTitle: Nothing has been sent to the Recycle Bin yet
trashlog.emptyLead: When you delete photos from the Limbo or repeated copies, they show here, with the space freed.
trashlog.freedHint: Photos marked to delete and sent to the Recycle Bin
trashlog.allSent: All sent to the Recycle Bin
trashlog.byMonth: Freed by the Limbo, month by month
trashlog.noLimbo: Nothing from the Limbo has gone to the Recycle Bin yet.
trashlog.listTitle: Files sent to the Recycle Bin
trashlog.copyTitle: Copies the list (date, file, folder, bytes, from) to paste into a spreadsheet
trashlog.copyFailed: The list could not be copied.
trashlog.byRootHint: How much left each drive or folder, and all of them together. Click one to see only it below.
adjust.eyedropperTitle: White balance: click a point that should be grey or white
adjust.eyedropperHint: Click a point of the photo that should be grey or white (Esc cancels).
adjust.autoTitle: Exposure, whites, blacks, contrast and vibrance worked out from the photo itself
adjust.presetsTitle: Adjustments kept with a name, to apply to other photos
adjust.bwTitle: Turns the photo black and white; the sliders below brighten or darken each colour
adjust.detailNoGpu: Because of an error starting the GPU, sharpness, texture and clarity cannot be turned on.
adjust.compareTitle: Before and after: drag the line to compare
adjust.title: Adjustments
adjust.allSelected.other: Moving a slider sets that value on all {count} selected photos.
adjust.copied: Adjustments copied: paste them on other photos.
adjust.pasteTitle.one: The copied adjustments on the selected photo
adjust.pasteTitle.other: The copied adjustments on the {count} selected photos
adjust.saveTitle: A new JPEG next to the original, with its metadata; the original does not change
adjust.cannotSave: These photos cannot be drawn at full size here (only JPEG, PNG, WebP… and raw files with a camera JPEG).
adjust.viewerNote: Adjusted in LionPhotos · hold here (or the \ key) to see the original
adjust.raw.noteOff: Raw photo: the adjustments are made on the JPEG the camera stored inside the file (8 bits), not on the raw data. The original file never changes.
adjust.raw.noteOn: Raw development: the adjustments are made on the sensor data, developed on this computer in 16 bits. The original file never changes.
adjust.raw.switch: Edit on the raw data in 16 bits (develop mode)
adjust.raw.hint: More room to bring back highlights and shadows, starting from the camera's white balance. A developed photo takes about a second to open, a few seconds to export.
adjust.raw.noGpu: Needs the graphics card (WebGL 2), which is not available here.
adjust.raw.failed: Could not develop the raw file: {error}
describe.writeNothing: Nothing written in LionPhotos to write to the files yet (what is shown comes from the files themselves).
describe.mixedShort: Different values — what you type goes on all
describe.fromFileTitle: What the photo’s own metadata says; change it to write your own
describe.pendingTitle: Written in LionPhotos, not in the file yet
describe.pending.one: {count} field not written to the file yet
describe.pending.other: {count} fields not written to the file yet
describe.mixedPick: See the values and pick one for all
describe.headline: Headline
describe.headlineHint: One line about the photo, without place and date
describe.allSelected.other: What you write here goes on all {count} selected photos.
describe.writeHint: Writes this metadata and the mark (as a rating) into the files, for other programs and for sending: inside the JPEG and in a .xmp next to it; in a .xmp next to other formats
describe.author: Author
describe.authorHint: Who took the photo — the credit of exported pages
describe.title: Description
describe.caption: Photo description
describe.altHint: Describe the image for people who cannot see it — screen readers say this text
describe.mixed: Different texts — what you write here goes on all of them
describe.safeCollection: Saved as you type: in the catalog, with a recovery copy written by itself in the collection’s folder (.lionphotos). The photos’ files change only when you write to them.
describe.safeLocal: Saved as you type, in the catalog on this computer. The photos’ files change only when you write to them.
describe.notInFile.one: {count} field not in the file yet.
describe.notInFile.other: {count} fields not in the file yet.
folderAlbums.buttonTitle: Create albums from the folders of the collection
folderAlbums.title: Albums from the folders
folderAlbums.lead: One album per folder you check, with the folder’s name.
folderAlbums.leadFolder: One album per folder you check, in “{folder}”.
folderAlbums.mode.leaf: The folders with photos in them
folderAlbums.modeHint.top: Each folder right under it becomes an album, with its subfolders.
folderAlbums.modeHint.leaf: Each folder that holds photos itself becomes an album.
folderAlbums.modeHint.none: Nothing checked: check the folders below.
folderAlbums.withParent: Name with the folder above (“Italy · Rome”)
folderAlbums.note: Each album stays tied to its whole folder: photos added to it later are in the album too. Only the LionPhotos catalog changes; no file is moved or copied.
openWith.title: Open with
openWith.none: No photo or video program found
openWith.manyMessage: Each file opens in the program, which can take a while with many photos.
renameFolder.title: Rename “{name}”
renameFolder.label: New name
limbo.title: Limbo
limbo.lead: The photos and videos marked as delete candidates wait here, out of Photos, until you decide: delete them (to the Recycle Bin, with the confirmation code) or bring them back.
limbo.restoreTitle: Out of the Limbo: back to Photos
limbo.sendTitle: The selected photos leave Photos and wait in the Limbo until you delete them or bring them back
limbo.confirmOne: Really send the file “{name}” to the Limbo?

todo.lead: The albums and projects marked with the pencil on their cover, in the order they are to be done: the first one at the top. Drag them (or use the arrows) to change the order; Done takes the pencil off. Only the catalog changes.
todo.keys: Drag to reorder · Alt+↑ ↓ on a row moves it
todo.howTo: Click the pencil on the cover of an album or a project (or “Mark to edit” in its ⋯ menu) to put it here. Then put first what has to be done first.
todo.doneTitle: Done: takes the pencil off (it leaves this list)
todo.pinOnTitle: To edit — number {n} in the list. Click to take the pencil off
